probes.name: reachability
probes.summary: 17 routes registered, 14 navigated to, 5 untyped casts

findings.title: Screen "Auth" is navigated to but is not in the active branch
findings.detail: Registered only inside a conditional branch of RootNavigator, yet navigated to from: src/features/profile/ProfileScreen.tsx. React Navigation cannot resolve a route that is not mounted in the active tree.

findings.title: Screen "MesocycleOverview" is registered but unreachable
findings.detail: Nothing anywhere calls navigate() with this route name, so a user cannot get to it. Either wire an entry point or remove the registration.

findings.title: 5 navigate() calls bypass the typed param list with "as never"
findings.detail: The RootStackParamList in src/navigation/types.ts is fully typed, but these casts opt out of it — which is precisely why the unreachable and cross-branch routes above compile cleanly: src/features/profile/ProfileScreen.tsx:103 -> MemoryDashboard; src/features/profile/ProfileScreen.tsx:113 -> PeriodReport; src/features/profile/ProfileScreen.tsx:123 -> InjuryManagement; src/features/profile/ProfileScreen.tsx:133 -> Auth; src/features/workouts/PostWorkoutScreen.tsx:114 -> MainTabs

probes.name: schema-drift
probes.summary: journal 1 · app 5 · drizzle-schema 14 tables · postgres 11 tables

findings.title: 4 migrations run by the app are absent from the Drizzle journal
findings.detail: src/lib/migrate.ts applies [0000_light_ghost_rider, 0001_intelligence_layer, 0002_mesocycle_programming, 0003_timer_chat_brief_readiness, 0004_agentic_memory] but drizzle/meta/_journal.json lists only [0000_light_ghost_rider]. Running `npm run db:generate` would diff the current schema against that stale baseline and regenerate migrations that already ran — corrupting the chain. Do not run db:generate until the journal is rebuilt.

findings.title: 4 migrations exist only as inline strings in migrate.ts
findings.detail: [0001_intelligence_layer, 0004_agentic_memory, 0003_timer_chat_brief_readiness, 0002_mesocycle_programming] have no .sql file under drizzle/ and no snapshot. They are unreviewable as migrations and invisible to drizzle-kit.

findings.title: 3 local tables have no Postgres equivalent
findings.detail: [chat_messages, daily_briefs, readiness_logs] exist in the local SQLite schema but in no supabase/migrations file. Sync could never push them. Expected while the backend is deliberately unprovisioned — it becomes a blocker the moment sync is switched on.

probes.name: activation
probes.summary: 1/4 statically checkable steps pass (2 of 6 steps need a device and are unverified)

findings.title: Activation step 2 fails: no user identity is ever established
findings.detail: userStore starts `id: null` and no setUser() call passes an id; no users row is ever inserted into SQLite. Every screen guards `if (!userId) return`, so the app renders empty shells after onboarding. PRAGMA foreign_keys is ON, so any workout insert would also violate the users FK.

findings.title: Activation step 3 fails: seedDatabase() is defined but never called
findings.detail: src/lib/seed.ts loads a 1,367-line exercise catalog and a 247-line injury-risk matrix, and has zero call sites. The Exercise Library renders empty, FTS5 search returns nothing, and every set log violates the exercise_performances -> exercises foreign key.

findings.title: Activation step 4 fails: a random user id is fabricated per workout
findings.detail: `input.userId ?? generateId()` at src/features/workouts/hooks/useWorkoutLifecycle.ts:68 masks the missing identity from step 2 instead of failing loudly, then writes a workout row whose user_id matches no users row. With foreign keys enabled that insert is invalid.
